evidence: Spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE, J. A. Woollam) was used to determine the thickness and refractive index of the as-deposited films. Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR, Nicolet Nexus 870) was performed ex situ on as-deposited samples. X-ray diffraction (XRD, Siemens Kristalloflex 810) was performed using a Cu Kα radiation source to determine the growth orientation of the thin films. Film morphology and conformality were determined using a field emission scanning electron microscope (FE-SEM, JEOL JSM-7000F).
